import sqlite3


class StudentDatabaseProcessor:

    def __init__(self, database_name):
        self._database_name = database_name

    def _get_connection(self):
        return sqlite3.connect(self._database_name)

    def _close_connection(self, conn):
        conn.close()

    def _create_table(self, cursor):
        create_table_query = """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT,
            age INTEGER,
            gender TEXT,
            grade INTEGER
        )
        """
        cursor.execute(create_table_query)

    def create_student_table(self):
        conn = self._get_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        self._create_table(cursor)
        conn.commit()
        self._close_connection(conn)

    def _insert_student(self, cursor, student_data):
        insert_query = """
        INSERT INTO students (name, age, gender, grade)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        """
        cursor.execute(insert_query,
                       (student_data['name'], student_data['age'], student_data['gender'], student_data['grade']))

    def insert_student(self, student_data):
        conn = self._get_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        self._insert_student(cursor, student_data)
        conn.commit()
        self._close_connection(conn)

    def _search_student_by_name(self, cursor, name):
        select_query = "SELECT * FROM students WHERE name = ?"
        cursor.execute(select_query, (name,))
        return cursor.fetchall()

    def search_student_by_name(self, name):
        conn = self._get_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        result = self._search_student_by_name(cursor, name)
        self._close_connection(conn)
        return result

    def _delete_student_by_name(self, cursor, name):
        delete_query = "DELETE FROM students WHERE name = ?"
        cursor.execute(delete_query, (name,))

    def delete_student_by_name(self, name):
        conn = self._get_connection()
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        self._delete_student_by_name(cursor, name)
        conn.commit()
        self._close_connection(conn)
